title: extract_seg_waveform
description: This program extracts an average waveform from an input volume where the average is computed over the voxels in the given segmentation indices. The input volume is mapped to the space of the segmentation given the registration, and if a voxel shift map (VSM) is supplied, it is applied simultaneously as part of the transform.

seg_indices.description: Segmentation indices, one or more indices can be specified
seg_indices.title: Segmentation Indices

vsm_file.description: Voxel shift map for B0 distortion correction
vsm_file.title: Voxel Shift Map

regheader_flag.description: Uses the header information in the registration file
regheader_flag.title: Registration Header Flag

demean_flag.description: Remove mean, first, and second order trends
demean_flag.title: Demean Flag
